notes: Official Roland Pro A/V spec page confirms all connectors. HDMI ports are unversioned in Roland's spec sheet (rated up to 1080p/HDCP support only), so no HDMI grade is stated by the manufacturer — omitted rather than inferred. Power: unit ships with an external AC adaptor (Roland PSB-7U, 3A/36W draw) connecting via a DC input on the rear panel; modeled as dc-barrel (closest match in the allowed connector list — Roland does not publish the exact barrel pin diameter). INPUT 4 is a shared/selectable analog bank (RGB/component via mini D-sub 15-pin, or composite via RCA) in addition to its HDMI input. MAIN OUT similarly provides simultaneous HDMI and RGB/Component (mini D-sub 15-pin) output. No SDI, no rack ears (this is a desktop/tabletop unit), hence rackUnits omitted.
